facts.value: Student/Young Adult Leap: weekly cap €10.20 (daily €2.55) on TFI Cork City buses; UCC budgets €26-€30/month
Mild and wet: mean daily max 8.2°C in Jan, 18.6°C in Jul; 1,239 mm rain/year, ~162 days with ≥1 mm (Cork Airport 1991-2020)
Described by UCC as a hub of culture and Ireland's food capital, hosting 24 major festivals a year
English: lectures are in English; UCC does not ask Erasmus students for a test but offers B2+ and C1 academic English courses
Casual and part-time jobs via the UCC student jobs portal, Students' Union site and notice boards; UCC says relying on part-time work to fund studies is not realistic
